name: StarChip multiplier
author: MegaRedHot, DecompRecomp
description: Multiplies the StarChips a won duel adds to the save. The results screen still shows the usual prize; only the balance is scaled (still capped at 999999).

settings.label: Multiplier
settings.description: How many times the duel's prize (1 to 5 StarChips from the rank, or a mod's starchip_prize) is added to the save.
